pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal and rhomboid regions with softened edge gradients likely due to image resolution. Patches on the flank exhibit significant spatial area relative to the light separators.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan pathways forming clear tri-junction and tetra-junction nodes across the visible flank and neck. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform and maintain topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense bristly silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge with high-frequency, low-amplitude geometric serrations.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Significant large, vertically-oriented elliptical region of pale textural disruption and de-pigmentation located on the mid-upper flank/shoulder area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large pale cutaneous lesion on the mid-flank; a small dark focal anomaly is also visible perched on the upper dorsal ridge profile.
other_distinctive_markers: The exceptionally large vertical pale anomaly on the mid-flank serves as a primary unique structural marker.
